title: ZIA Mobile Security: Mobile Malware Protection and Mobile App Store Control

prose.text: Mobile Security has two policies, and the question decides which subject answers.

steps.label: Is an app blocked for what it does?
steps.text: The security and privacy actions, their default and the recommended policy are in [[zia.mobile-security.malware-protection]].

steps.label: Is an app store blocked for downloads?
steps.text: The browse-but-not-download rules, their criteria and limits are in [[zia.mobile-security.app-store-control]].

prose.text: Which of the two policies needs the Mobile Security subscription is open {{gap:mobile-subscription}}.

mobile-subscription.title: Which Mobile Security policy needs the subscription
mobile-subscription.detail: Each help page attributes the Mobile Security subscription to the other policy: the Mobile Malware Protection page says a subscription enables App Store policies, and the Mobile App Store Control page says it enables malware policies. Which policy needs it is not settled by these pages.
